expect_red: [real] ground truth: the MS14101-3 pitch-link bearing reads as its own catalog page, and its ball centre is the part origin

mutations.contract: The centre this surface reports is the FITTED centre of the face's own sphere. It is the one number a spherical joint has that a plane and a cylinder do not, and scripts/fit_bound_features.py multiplies it by an assembly placement and hands the result to a solver in another repo.
mutations.note: The mutation moves the centre half a millimetre along X -- small enough to look like geometry and far too large to be one. It is the shape of a sign or an index slip rather than of a deleted feature, and the [real] tier's catalog pairing is what notices it, because the installed bearing's ball really is centred on its part origin.
